title: Single-Exponential Parameterized Counting over Unbreakable Decompositions in Haskell
topic: Counting over Unbreakable Decompositions: A Single-Exponential Parameterized Algorithm
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We study the problem of counting independent sets in graphs whose treewidth is bounded by a parameter $k$. By exploiting a balanced tree decomposition and a dynamic-programming scheme that enumerates independent subsets of each bag, we obtain a single-exponential algorithm with running time $O(2^{k}\cdot n)$. The algorithm preserves a strict height-balanced invariant on the decomposition tree and guarantees that each DP table entry corresponds to a valid independent set. We provide a formal invariant proof, a static-analysis profile of the Haskell implementation, and a theoretical complexity analysis. The source code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/haskell-functional-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261108_020129_counting_over_unbreakable_deco}.
